nodes.title: B. Definitions
nodes.summary: The text outlines insurance coverage under CyberShield, including conditions for Cyber Bullying/Defamation and Extortion Loss claims, Data Recovery Coverage, and Media Liability Coverage, along with specific reporting requirements, documentation, and limits. It details exclusions for each section, such as losses from journalists or non-digital media, and general exclusions like dishonest conduct, bodily injury, property damage, business activities, intellectual property disputes, war, and government actions. Additionally, it provides definitions for key terms used in the policy, such as Bank Account, Cyber Incident, Data Extortion Threat, and others, and specifies the policy's scope, including the discovery period and retroactive date.

nodes.title: C. Exclusions
nodes.summary: The text defines key terms related to a cyber insurance policy, including personal information, phishing, mobile wallet, online media activities, non-fiat currency, policy, policyholder, policy period, retroactive date, terrorism, theft of funds, third party, third party claim, unauthorized access, and pronouns. It lists exclusions such as retroactive date, dishonest conduct, bodily injury, property damage, business activities, intellectual property, war, government authority, non-fiat currency, outage, illegal data use, unauthorized data collection, pre-notification expenses, insolvency, and immoral services. It also outlines general conditions for reporting claims, other insurance, claims conditions, fraudulent claims, limit of liability, and sanctions.

nodes.title: D. General Conditions
nodes.summary: The text outlines exclusions such as non-fiat currency losses, outage/disturbance loss, illegal use of data, unauthorized data collection, expenses before claim notification, insolvency of bank or mobile wallet, and immoral/obscene services. It then details general conditions including claim reporting procedures and required documentation, other insurance obligations, claims conditions (prior written consent, INR payment), fraudulent claims consequences, limit of liability (aggregate and sub limits), and sanctions. Finally, it provides insurer contact and registration details.
